scope: M8-EDITOR main view; independent preview remains M8-OUTPUTS

configuration.dependencies: system .NET SDK, x64 hosting pack and Windows Desktop runtime; offline restore with no NuGet package sources

deployment.path_policy: native and managed artifacts resolve beside the executable; configured system hostfxr path is recorded in CMakeCache

abi.matrix: pointer to sixteen finite float32 values, copied before callback

lifetime: editor STA owns windows, native level and callbacks; renderer/session/channels ready before the first level query; native handles/cooks drain after render close; HWNDs and callbacks survive Vulkan teardown; managed context disposed before native module unload; CoreCLR/hostfxr are process-owned

launch.automated_window: hidden, nonactivating, input-transparent, explicitly opted into fenced readback

toolbar_commands.3: add unused alias layer to isolated bar cell
toolbar_commands.5: exchange dominant bar terrain texture across scene
toolbar_commands.7: toggle copied UI quad and depth-disabled debug triangle
toolbar_commands.8: isolate bar cell / restore both cells

terrain_edit_budget.rule: isolate bar before adding a slot; remove the extra slot before restoring both cells; original authored cells/geometry/weights/files stay unchanged

verification.unused_layer_add_remove: both images exactly equal isolated-cell image; committed binding/query statistics required
verification.common_game_images: all original 37 shots must match current game and frozen accepted game captures byte-for-byte

overlay_oracle.debug_linear_input: (0,85/255,0); Reinhard maps green to 1/4 before sRGB
